newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK&S Hotels says rights issue subscribed.
newsitem.headline: HK&S Hotels says rights issue subscribed.

text.p: Hongkong and Shanghai Hotels Ltd said on Monday its rights issue on 90.10 million new shares was 1.12 times subscribed.
In October, the hotel group said it planned to raise HK$1.2 billion by means of a one-for-12 rights issue at HK$13.10 per rights share.

The company earlier made significant investment in the redevelopment of Hong Kong's The Peak Tower and upgrading of older apartments in the Repulse Bay complex, as well as the upgrading of the Peninsula Manila.
It said it planned to acquire the Quali Lodge resort and housing development in California and a majority stake in the Bennelong apartment project in Sydney.
